name: smwpatches-no-shooting-fireballs-cape-spin-when-carrying-something
title: No Shooting Fireballs/Cape Spin When Carrying Something
description:
This patch fixes a oversight bug in SMW that allows the player to shoot fireballs or do cape spin while carrying a sprite. Nintendo did not expect players to have 2 buttons both for carrying and throwing a fireball.

You can also add a freeram that also disables throwing fireballs:
Code
;	ORA $xxxxxx        ;>Custom freeram to disable fireball

^Remove the semicolon and add a custom freeram.
